{"problem": "使用如下自定义运算：

定义：
\[
f\,■\,g=\frac{\partial f}{\partial x}+\frac{\partial g}{\partial x}.
\]

已知：
\[
 f(x,y)=\frac{- x^{2} + 4 x \left(y - 2\right) + 5}{2 \left(y - 2\right)},\quad g(x,y)=2 \left(- x + 2 y + 3\right)^{2}.
\]

求：\(f\,■\,g\)。请用 LaTeX 作答，并用双中括号包裹：[[...]]。", "canonical_answer": "[[\frac{- x - 2 \left(y - 2\right) \left(- 2 x + 4 y + 5\right)}{y - 2}]]", "attempts": [{"panel": 0, "sample": 0, "answer": "[[\frac{\partial f}{\partial x}+\frac{\partial g}{\partial x}=4x-8y-10-\frac{x}{y-2}]]", "certificate": "对 \(x\) 求偏导（要求 \(y\ne2\)）：\(\frac{\partial f}{\partial x}=2-\frac{x}{y-2}\)，\(\frac{\partial g}{\partial x}=-4(-x+2y+3)=4x-8y-12\)。相加得 \(4x-8y-10-\frac{x}{y-2}\)。"}]}

message.content: {"verdict":"valid","reason":"对 f 和 g 分别关于 x 求偏导可得 \\(\\frac{\\partial f}{\\partial x}=2-\\frac{x}{y-2}\\) 与 \\(\\frac{\\partial g}{\\partial x}=4x-8y-12\\)，相加为 \\(4x-8y-10-\\frac{x}{y-2}\\)。该结果通分后正好等于标准答案，且定义域要求 \\(y\\ne2\\)。","error_types":[],"depth_score":2,"depth_evidence":"需要先分别计算两个函数关于 x 的偏导，再将结果相加并验证其与标准答案的代数等价性。","reasoning_type_tags":["deduction","arithmetic","algebra"],"constraint_type_tags":["equality","other"],"scenario":"abstract","explanation_score":4,"explanation_evidence":"证书明确给出了两个偏导数的计算过程及相加结果；结果与标准答案通分展开后完全一致，并指出了 \\(y\\ne2\\) 的定义域条件。","solver_correct":[true]}
